transcript: Kenton Clawstar. Designer, artiste, and, when absolutely necessary, adventurer. I deal in fine silks, finer entrances, and problems best handled at the end of a whip. If our group is in danger or if there is money to be had, naturally I’ll be there. Someone has to make survival look fashionable.

Therric Balenfore. Ranger, monk, and the one who checks the tracks before everyone else walks into trouble. I trust the ground, the wind, and what a frightened man leaves unsaid. I move ahead, I bring my friends home, and when Kenton has a plan... I make sure someone packs bandages. If the wilds are watching us, I intend to notice first.
